parts.t: Welcome to The Grove! This bright and well-kept 1 bed + den home offers 726 sq ft of functional living in a convenient Walnut Grove location. The open layout features a comfortable living space, spacious kitchen, and a versatile den perfect for a home office, nursery, or extra storage. Enjoy the added convenience of secure parking, storage locker, and being close to shopping, restaurants, parks, schools, transit, Carvolth Bus Exchange, and quick Hwy 1 access. A great opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors!

v: Bright, well-kept 1 bed + den offering 726 sq ft of functional single-level living. Open layout with a comfortable living space and spacious kitchen
A flexible second room that works as a home office, nursery, or additional storage — the kind of square footage a straight one-bedroom doesn't give you.
Secure parking plus a storage locker included.
Close to shopping, restaurants, parks, schools, and transit. Carvolth Bus Exchange and quick Highway 1 access make the commute straightforward in either direction.
